en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a tree-lined street with several pedestrians and a few horse-drawn carriages. The street is flanked by European-style buildings with classical architectural features. Leafless trees line both sides of the street. The overall appearance is early 20th century, and the image has a sepia tone. At the top, the text 'LISBOA – Rua D. Estefania' is visible, indicating the location.
